title.zh: 企业级 Copilot 智能体治理、四维控制面与生产发布架构（THR981）
title.en: Enterprise Copilot Agent Intake, Four-Pillar Control Plane & Production Readiness (THR981)

label.zh: 1. CoE 需求分诊与存在性裁决层（CoE Intake & Operating Model）
label.en: 1. CoE Intake, Triage & Operating Model Layer

label.zh: 2. 规模化治理核心支柱（Agent 365 + Managed Environments + Microsoft Purview）
label.en: 2. Scale Governance Control Plane (Agent 365 + DLP + Microsoft Purview)

label.zh: 3. 五类变更重验与四阶生产放行流水线（Enterprise Production Readiness Path）
label.en: 3. Change Re-Validation & Four-Gate Production Release Pipeline

label.zh: 存在性与工具选型分诊

detail.zh: 先甄别是否该用 Workspaces、Cowork 或 SharePoint 流，拒绝把一切需求做成智能体
detail.en: Filter out tasks better served by Workspaces, Cowork, or SharePoint workflows

label.zh: CoE 定级与实名责任人绑定

detail.zh: 无责任人则无智能体；划分 Zone 1–3 风险等级并预设员工离职所有权交接机制
detail.en: No owner, no agent; assign Zone 1–3 risk tier, business KPIs & succession plan

label.zh: 数据源收敛与双层目录约束

detail.zh: 规避 Agent Builder 仅穿透 2 层目录上限，收敛分散非结构化文档为唯一权威信源
detail.en: Flatten SharePoint depth (<=2 levels for Agent Builder) into one authoritative source

label.zh: Agent 365 资产台账与跨管理员协同

detail.zh: 向 CoE 开放 Agent 365 视野，联动 Entra、Power Platform 与 SharePoint 专职管理员
detail.en: Empower CoE with Agent 365 visibility across Entra, Power Platform & SharePoint

label.zh: 托管环境与连接器级 DLP 围栏

detail.zh: 叫停 Default 环境混跑；个人环境锁死 M365 连接器，企业级严格走 Dev/Test/Prod
detail.en: Stop Default env builds; lock personal env to M365 and enforce Dev/Test/Prod ALM

label.zh: Microsoft Purview 敏感标签与审计

detail.zh: 落实数据分类、最小权限与禁止动作清单；结合 Purview Audit 追踪业务结果指标
detail.en: Enforce sensitivity labels, least-privilege scopes, Purview Audit & outcome KPIs

label.zh: 五类变更强制退回重测触发器

detail.zh: 指令或模型（视同公司章程）、知识源、工具动作、系统集成或编排任一变更即退回测试
detail.en: Changes to instructions/model, knowledge, tools, integrations, or orchestration

label.zh: 回归 · 质量安全 · 红队对抗三联测

detail.zh: 由受信任测试员在类生产环境校验既有场景、安全阈值与越权误用边界
detail.en: Trusted testers verify existing scenarios, safety policies & misuse edge cases

label.zh: 实名责任人签署与渐进推广

detail.zh: 责任人正式签署验收后，按受控试点 → 业务部门部署 → 全企业规模化阶梯放行
detail.en: Named owner signs off readiness across Controlled Pilot → Business → Enterprise

label.zh: 确需新建智能体
登记责任人与分区
匹配环境与 DLP
挂载敏感度标签
Dev → Test 提测
触发强制重验
四关合拢签署
持续监控与退役阈值
